assessments.name: payment_integrity
assessments.supported_capability: Source-custodied, reconciled, program-period-aware payment-accuracy measurement with bounded factual reporting and explicit methodology review.
assessments.binding_gap: No candidate-specific causal prevention or same-cohort collection lineage with cost, false-positive, appeal, access, and distribution floors.
assessments.next_evidence_action: Run one candidate-scoped same-cohort prevention or collection pilot with implementation cost and beneficiary-protection evidence.

assessments.name: net_interest
assessments.supported_capability: An explicit accounting guardrail plus a hash-custodied FY2025-FY2035 annual CBO debt, net-interest, and other-financing baseline whose zero-policy topline identities replay deterministically.
assessments.binding_gap: No admitted maturity-bucket stock, rollover rule, bucket-rate and stress path, borrowing timing, gross-to-net interest bridge, or primary-balance feedback result.
assessments.next_evidence_action: Reconcile Treasury MSPD securities to CBO debt held by the public, define annual rollover and bucket-rate rules, and then prove one admitted primary-balance shock changes later debt and interest.

assessments.name: revenue_solvency
assessments.supported_capability: A versioned internal policy and score-request handoff with planning, behavior, and stress schedules and an explicit publication gate.
assessments.binding_gap: No official score, Legislative Counsel text, or complete matched-base, incidence, distribution, administration, compliance, interaction, macro, timing, and debt-service results.
assessments.next_evidence_action: Freeze one policy version and complete an authorized official-score intake package while closing matched-base, distribution, and administration inputs.
